title: Flag Generator
statement: Create a flag generator that computes zero, negative, parity, and carry flags from an 8-bit arithmetic result and carry-in signal. The module should produce outputs suitable for a processor status register. The logic must be combinational.
module_signature: module flag_generator(input [7:0] result, input carry_in, output zero, output negative, output parity, output carry_out);
behavior: parity is 1 when result contains an even number of ones.
carry_out mirrors carry_in for this block.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
example:
result carry_in | zero negative parity carry_out
00000000 0 | 1 0 1 0
hint: Compute flags from the result bits and carry signal.
